inputs.text: Job Sikhala is right: people should reject amendments that could keep President Emmerson Mnangagwa in power until 2030. Extending a leader’s tenure would concentrate power further in the hands of political elites while leaving ordinary people with even less say over decisions affecting their lives. This is a question of democratic accountability and whose voices count. Zimbabwe needs an open debate and institutions that protect everyone’s right to choose who governs them.
